title: Why Is the Middle Still Cold? #microwave #science
description:
Microwaves don't cook from the inside out. Most of their power is gone 1–2 cm into the food, so only a thin outer layer heats directly and the middle waits for slow conduction.

subtitles: Why is the middle still cold?
Leftovers, three minutes in the microwave.
Microwaves don't cook from the inside out.
They shake the water in your food, and that water soaks up their energy fast.
1–2 cm in, most of their power is already gone.
So only a thin outer layer heats up directly.
The middle has to wait for that heat to creep inward, and creeping takes many minutes.
That's why the packet says stir it, or let it stand.
Skip that, and the middle often stays cold.
